runtimeCpuInspection.method: Pure CPU invocation of actual resource factories via installed TypeScript transpileModule and Three; no renderer/context/device or GPU upload

environmentAllocations.formulaApproximation: 4 surfaces * 2 textures per surface * size^2 * 4 bytes * 4/3 mip factor
environmentAllocations.cachePolicy: module-owned immutable pixels/relief by surface:size; 4 surfaces * 2 allowed resolutions; scene textures reuse CPU data but own distinct Texture objects
environmentAllocations.owner: createEnvironmentArtResources creates 8 textures, 11 materials, 3 geometries per scene owner; dispose frees these objects; createSceneResources calls art.dispose
environmentAllocations.colorSpace: color=sRGB; relief/roughness=NoColorSpace; RGBA8; RepeatWrapping; linear mag, trilinear mip min
environmentAllocations.lowBumpPolicy: bumpMap null at low, roughnessMap retained; eight textures in either quality
environmentAllocations.scopeLimit: Image allocation math and CPU array sizes, not driver GPU memory, render targets, uniforms, shader programs, total app memory, GPU time, FPS or device measurement
